component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
function lists() as object return ["grid", "mlist", "list", "rows", "pgrid"] end function
sub init() names = ["Home", "Movies", "Shows", "Music", "Search", "Settings", "Profile"] for each id in ["grid", "mlist", "list", "pgrid"] root = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") for each name in names item = root.createChild("ContentNode") item.title = name item.HDGridPosterUrl = "pkg:/images/solid.png" item.SDGridPosterUrl = "pkg:/images/solid.png" end for m.top.findNode(id).content = root end for rowRoot = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") row = rowRoot.createChild("ContentNode") for each name in names row.createChild("ContentNode").title = name end for m.top.findNode("rows").content = rowRoot end sub
' Launch parameter fp=green swaps every list's footprint to an opaque green image. sub onFootprint() for each id in lists() m.top.findNode(id).focusFootprintBitmapUri = m.top.footprint end for end sub
' Launch parameter ontop=false|true writes drawFocusFeedbackOnTop on every list. sub onOnTop() for each id in lists() m.top.findNode(id).drawFocusFeedbackOnTop = (m.top.onTop = "true") end for end sub
sub onTarget() for each id in lists() node = m.top.findNode(id) print "PROBE|" + id + " footprint=" + node.focusFootprintBitmapUri + " blend=" + node.focusFootprintBlendColor.toStr() + " onTop=" + node.drawFocusFeedbackOnTop.toStr() end for m.top.findNode(m.top.target).setFocus(true) print "PROBE|focused " + m.top.target end sub
